title: L'ort vilain jaloux (Bologna Q19) (Mouton)
desc: Jean Mouton, L'ort vilain jaloux (Bologna Q19). 4 voices (Superius, Altus, Tenor, Bassus), each on its own staff. Source: Bologna Q19. No text in this edition.
